title: Human-approved planning evidence integration update
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 2 request to proceed with priorities 1 through 6. Extend the public HPCI lifecycle inventory, register comparable operational evidence without inferring chart values, refine public procurement and five-year cost evidence without calling contractual lower bounds TCO, expand the EEA1 performance evidence and quantitative requirement surface, and connect all five evidence dimensions to the three system planning options. Keep every research result provisional and Consensus-incomplete. Validate, push, and create a bilingual reviewable pull request. Do not merge the pull request or deploy production GitHub Pages without a separate explicit instruction.
